corporate_announcements.summary: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Divestment of entire equity stake in Tata Steel Colors Private Limited
corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: Ref: SEC/1500/2026-27 November 22, 2026 The Secretary, Listing Department The Manager, Listing Department BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor, Plot No. C/1, Dalal Street, G Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra, Mumbai - 400 001. Mumbai - 400 051. Maharashtra, India. Maharashtra, India. Scrip Code: 500470 Symbol: TATASTEEL Dear Madam, Sirs, Sub: Outcome of Board Meeting of Tata Steel Limited The Board of Directors (‘Board’) of Tata Steel Limited (‘Company’) at its meeting held today, i.e. November 22, 2026, inter alia, transacted the following business: 1. Transfer of Tubes Business of the Company and entering into Business Transfer Agreement between the Company and APL Apollo Tubes Limited Considered and approved the transfer of the business of manufacturing, processing, marketing, sale and distribution of steel tubes and pipes at and from the steel tubes manufacturing facilities of the Company at Jamshedpur, Hosur, Khopoli and Sahibabad, in each case, including products manufactured directly by the Company or through contract manufacturing arrangements, and certain cold rolling and surface coated steel product facilities at Khopoli, together with all related plants, facilities, operations and activities ancillary or incidental thereto (‘Tubes Business’) of the Company to APL Apollo Tubes Limited (‘APL Apollo’), as a going concern on a slump sale basis for a lump sum consideration of up to ₹11,700 crore. Towards this, the Board also considered and approved the Business Transfer Agreement (‘BTA’) to be entered into between the Company and APL Apollo. The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent, including approval from Regulatory Authorities as may be necessary. For further details refer to Annexure 1. 2. Divestment of entire equity stake in Tata Steel Colors Private Limited The Company directly holds 43,30,00,000 equity shares representing 50% equity stake in its wholly owned subsidiary Tata Steel Colors Private Limited (formerly known as Tata BlueScope Steel Private Limited) (‘TSCL’). The Company, indirectly through its another wholly owned subsidiary, Tata Steel Downstream Products Limited (‘TSDPL’), holds the balance 43,30,00,000 equity shares representing the remaining 50% equity stake in TSCL. The Board of the Company at its meeting held today, considered and approved the sale and transfer of its entire equity stake of 100% (held directly or indirectly through one of its wholly owned subsidiaries, TSDPL), in its wholly owned subsidiary, TSCL, to APL Apollo, for a consideration of ₹16,300 crore. The Board also considered and approved the Share Purchase Agreement to be entered into between the Company, TSCL, TSDPL and APL Apollo, pursuant to which each of the Company and TSDPL will sell their entire shareholding in TSCL to APL Apollo for an aggregate consideration of ₹16,300 crore. Upon consummation of the transactions contemplated under the Share Purchase Agreement (‘SPA’), 100% of the total paid up equity share capital of TSCL will be owned by APL Apollo. The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent, including approval from Regulatory Authorities as may be necessary. Post this transaction, TSCL will cease to be a subsidiary of the Company. For further details on this transaction, please refer to Annexure 2. The Board meeting commenced at 1 p.m. (IST) and concluded at 5 p.m. (IST). These disclosures are being made pursuant to Regulat

corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: GLOBAL EDUCATION LIMITED CORPORATE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER(CIN) - L80301MH2011PLC219291 Registered Office : Office No.205,02nd Floor Jaisingh Business Center Premises CHSL,Sahar Road, Parsiwada, Andheri(E), Mumbai - 400099 , Maharashtra - India Tel No. +91 22 49242584, e-mail id : investorinfo@globaledu.net.in, Website : www.globaledu.net.in Through Online Filing GEL/CS/413 Dated: Friday 20th November 2026 To, The Manager, Listing Department, National Stock Exchange of India Limited Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block –G, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai – 400051, Maharashtra, India Reference: Symbol: GLOBAL ISIN No: INE291W01037 Sub: Submission of Letter of Offer for Buy-back of Equity Shares of Global Education Limited (“Company”) through the Tender Offer route pursuant to the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018, as amended, and the Companies Act, 2013 Dear Sir/Madam, With reference to the captioned Buy-back and in continuation of our earlier intimations, including the Public Announcement dated October 29, 2026, published in the newspapers on October 30, 2026 and October 31, 2026, we hereby submit the Letter of Offer dated November 20, 2026, together with the Form of Acceptance-cum-Acknowledgement (“Tender Form”), in connection with the Buy-back of up to 14,75,000 (Fourteen Lakh Seventy Five Thousand) fully paid-up Equity Shares of face value ₹2 each of the Company, at a price of ₹162 (Rupees One Hundred Sixty Two only) per Equity Share, for an aggregate consideration not exceeding ₹23,89,50,000 (Rupees Twenty Three Crore Eighty Nine Lakh Fifty Thousand only), excluding transaction costs. The Letter of Offer is proposed to be dispatched/disseminated to the Eligible Shareholders in accordance with the applicable SEBI Buy-back Regulations. You are requested to take note of the following schedule of activities in relation to the Buy-back: Sr. Activity Day Date No. Record Date for determining the names of Eligible 1 Wednesday November 18, 2026 Shareholders and their Buy-back Entitlement 2 Last date for dispatch of the Letter of Offer Friday November 20, 2026 3 Buy-back Opening Date Monday November 23, 2026 4 Buy-back Closing Date Monday November 30, 2026 5 Last date for receipt of completed Tender Forms and Monday November 30, 2026 GLOBAL EDUCATION LIMITED CORPORATE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER(CIN) - L80301MH2011PLC219291 Registered Office : Office No.205,02nd Floor Jaisingh Business Center Premises CHSL,Sahar Road, Parsiwada, Andheri(E), Mumbai - 400099 , Maharashtra - India Tel No. +91 22 49242584, e-mail id : investorinfo@globaledu.net.in, Website : www.globaledu.net.in other specified documents by the Registrar to the Buy- (up to 5:00 p.m.) back Last date for completion of settlement of bids on the 6 Monday December 7, 2026 Stock Exchange, including payment of consideration Note: Activities for which last dates are mentioned may be completed on or before the respective dates, in accordance with applicable law. The Letter of Offer and Tender Form shall also be made available on the website of the Company at www.globaledu.net.in, and on the websites of the Manager to the Buy-back, Registrar to the Buy-back and other relevant authorities, as applicable. All capitalised terms used herein but not specifically defined shall have the meanings assigned to them in the Letter of Offer. We request you to kindly take the above submission on record. Thanking you, Sincerely, FOR GLOBAL EDUCATION LIMITED CS PR
